title: Painting & Finishing
shortDescription: Prepare surfaces, choose the right tools and achieve a cleaner finish.
description: Learn how surface preparation, masking, tool selection and steady application create a better finish. This practical introduction covers indoor painting workflows and safe cleanup for new painters.
objectives: Prepare and protect a work area
Select brushes and rollers for common surfaces
Clean tools and store materials safely

modules.title: Planning and preparation
modules.summary: Protect people and surfaces before opening paint.

lessons.title: Prepare the room and work area
lessons.description: Move or cover furniture, ventilate the space and organize materials before beginning.

lessons.title: Clean and prepare a surface
lessons.description: Identify loose paint, dust, small holes and uneven areas that affect the final finish.

modules.title: Tools and paint application
modules.summary: Choose suitable tools and apply paint with an even technique.

lessons.title: Brushes, rollers and masking
lessons.description: Match common brushes and rollers to a task and use masking tape to protect clean edges.

lessons.title: Apply an even coat
lessons.description: Learn about loading a roller, working in sections and keeping a wet edge for consistent coverage.

modules.title: Finishing and cleanup
modules.summary: Check the result and leave tools and the work area in good condition.

lessons.title: Inspect the finish
lessons.description: Check for missed areas, drips and uneven coverage and understand when a second coat is needed.

lessons.title: Clean tools and store materials
lessons.description: Clean reusable tools, close containers and dispose of leftover materials safely.
